en.name: Zucchini
en.summary: Zucchini is a summer squash picked young, with thin skin and no hard rind, which is why it keeps nothing like a winter squash. Whole and fresh it holds about 1 week in the fridge. Blanched and frozen it keeps good quality for about 10 months.
en.pantry: Zucchini is mostly water under a skin thin enough to bruise with a thumbnail, so a warm kitchen shrivels it fast. There is no room-temperature timeline for it. Bring it home, dry off any surface water, and refrigerate it whole and unwashed. Anywhere near ripening fruit is a bad spot — the ethylene those give off yellows it.
en.fridge: Store zucchini whole and unwashed in the crisper at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, where it holds about 1 week. Leave it loose or in a bag you have not sealed tight: completely sealed in plastic it sweats and turns slimy, and completely bare it goes limp and wrinkled. Do not cut it until you cook — a cut face weeps and moulds within a couple of days even wrapped.
en.freezer: Freezing works, but blanch first, because raw frozen zucchini thaws into grey mush. Slice or grate it, blanch briefly, chill it in iced water, squeeze grated zucchini dry, then pack it flat in sealed bags at −18 °C (0 °F) for about 10 months of good quality. Frozen food held at that temperature stays safe indefinitely; the limit is texture and flavour. Grated and frozen in measured portions is by far the most useful form for baking and soups.
en.thawing: Cook sliced zucchini straight from frozen. Grated zucchini for baking can be thawed in the fridge and squeezed dry before use; never thaw it on the counter.
spoilage: A soft, wrinkled or bendy courgette that no longer feels firm
Wet, sunken spots, usually starting at the stem or blossom end
A slimy film on the skin, typically after being sealed in plastic
Mould at the cut end, or hollow, cottony flesh inside
tips: Choose small, firm, glossy courgettes; oversized ones are watery and seedy.
Store dry and unwashed, and wash just before cooking.
Keep it away from apples, bananas and tomatoes.
Grate any glut and freeze it in weighed portions for cakes and soups.

faq.q: How long does zucchini last in the fridge?
faq.a: About 1 week whole and unwashed in the crisper at 4 °C or below.
Yes. Blanch slices or squeeze grated zucchini dry first, then freeze at −18 °C for about 10 months of good quality.

faq.q: Why did my zucchini go slimy?
faq.a: Almost always moisture sealed in with it. Store it loose or in an unsealed bag so it can breathe.

faq.q: Can you eat zucchini with soft spots?
faq.a: If a single small spot can be cut well away and the rest is firm, yes. A courgette that is soft along its length or mouldy goes in the bin.

zh.name: 櫛瓜
zh.summary: 櫛瓜是趁嫩採收的夏季南瓜，皮薄、沒有硬殼，所以完全不像冬南瓜那樣耐放。整條新鮮的櫛瓜冷藏大約可放 1 週。先汆燙再冷凍的話，風味大約可維持 10 個月。
zh.pantry: 櫛瓜幾乎都是水，外皮薄到用指甲就能壓傷，溫暖的廚房會讓它很快皺縮。它沒有常溫保存的天數。買回家把表面的水擦乾，整條不洗直接冷藏。也不要放在正在後熟的水果旁邊——那些水果釋出的乙烯會讓它變黃。
zh.fridge: 整條、不清洗，放進 4 °C 以下的蔬果室，大約 1 週。鬆鬆地放著或用沒有封緊的袋子裝：完全密封在塑膠袋裡會出水變黏，完全裸放又會軟掉起皺。要煮之前才切——切面即使包起來，也會在一兩天內滲水發霉。
zh.freezer: 可以冷凍，但要先汆燙，因為生凍的櫛瓜解凍後是一團灰泥。切片或刨絲後快速汆燙、冰水冰鎮，刨絲的要擠乾水分，再攤平裝進密封袋放 −18 °C，風味大約可維持 10 個月。食物在這個溫度下安全性可以無限期維持，限制的是口感和味道。刨絲後按份量秤好冷凍，是拿來烘焙和煮湯最實用的形式。
zh.thawing: 切片的櫛瓜直接從冷凍下鍋。要做烘焙用的刨絲櫛瓜可以放冷藏解凍後擠乾再用；絕對不要放在室溫解凍。
spoilage: 整條變軟、起皺、可以彎曲，不再結實
出現濕潤凹陷的斑點，通常從蒂頭或花蒂端開始
表皮有黏膜，通常是密封在塑膠袋裡造成的
切口長霉，或裡面變得中空、像棉絮
tips: 挑小條、結實、表皮有光澤的；太大條的多水又多籽。
乾燥不清洗存放，下鍋前再洗。
一次買太多就刨絲秤好份量冷凍，做蛋糕、煮湯都好用。

faq.q: 櫛瓜放冰箱可以放多久？
faq.a: 整條不洗放在 4 °C 以下的蔬果室，大約 1 週。
可以。切片先汆燙，或刨絲擠乾，再放 −18 °C 冷凍，風味大約可維持 10 個月。
幾乎都是水氣被封在裡面。請鬆放或用不封緊的袋子裝，讓它透氣。

faq.q: 櫛瓜有小軟點還能吃嗎？
faq.a: 如果只有一小點、可以切掉一大圈而其餘部分還結實，就可以。整條都軟掉或發霉的就要丟。
